items.label: RISK-OFF — S&P 500 at 2026 Lows
items.detail: S&P 500 at 6,672 — lowest close of 2026. VIX 24.23. Fear & Greed 22/100. All 3 major US indices below 2026 opening levels. Energy only sector with positive YTD performance. Nasdaq -9.4% YTD.

items.label: Iran War Day 13 — Strait of Hormuz Sealed
items.detail: New Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei formally confirmed Strait of Hormuz remains closed. ~20% of global oil supply blocked. Brent $100.46 (+9.22%), WTI $95.73 (+9.72%). Scenario A: ceasefire → Brent $75-80. Scenario B: escalation → Brent $130+, recession. Polymarket: ceasefire within 30 days = 28%.

items.label: Brent Breaks $100 — Oil Shock
items.detail: Brent crude crossed $100/barrel for the first time since 2022. WTI at $95.73. Airlines down 8-9%. Consumer inflation risk rising. Oil above $90 for 10+ consecutive days. Every $10 increase = ~0.4% additional US CPI. Fed trapped: can't cut with oil shock in progress.

items.label: Recession Probability at 32% — Polymarket
items.detail: US recession probability hit 32% on Polymarket prediction markets — highest since 2023. Dual shock of oil surge + tariffs creating stagflation environment. CME FedWatch: 44.7% probability of ZERO rate cuts in 2026, up from 20% two weeks ago. Consumer spending under pressure.

items.label: PPI February + Triple Witching OpEx — Today
items.detail: Friday March 13: PPI February at 08:30 ET (expected +0.3% MoM). Triple witching options expiration — index options, stock options, futures all expire simultaneously. Elevated intraday volatility expected. Michigan Consumer Sentiment at 09:55 ET (expected ~63).

items.label: FOMC Meeting — March 18-19
items.detail: Next FOMC meeting in 5 days. No rate change expected but updated dot plot + SEP will reveal how Fed views the oil shock. Hawks may push for a hawkish hold; doves will argue for September cut. Powell press conference will be closely watched.

items.label: Trump Global 15% Tariff Plan
items.detail: Trump administration planning new global 15% base tariff (Section 122, up to 1 year). Countries buying Iranian oil already face +25% tariff. EU warned these violate WTO agreements; trade talks frozen. Second inflationary vector: imported goods more expensive simultaneously with oil shock.

items.label: CPI February — Result: +2.4% YoY ✅
items.detail: February CPI: +2.4% YoY (inline), +0.3% MoM, core +2.5%. Shelter and food main contributors. On its own the data would have been neutral/bullish. But with Brent now at $100, March CPI is at serious upside risk.

items.label: XOM — Oil Shock Momentum, score 90
items.detail: ExxonMobil +6.8% on March 12. Breakout above $148 resistance on 3x volume. Every $10 Brent = ~$3-4B additional Exxon FCF. Entry $152.50, Stop $145, TP1 $165, TP2 $175, R:R 1:1.6.

items.label: GLD — Gold Safe Haven / Stagflation Hedge, score 87
items.detail: Gold near ATH above $5,100/oz. Real rates declining. Central bank demand (China, India, Turkey) structural floor. Stagflation hedge: performs when inflation high + growth slowing. Entry $466, Stop $450, TP1 $490, TP2 $510, R:R 1:1.5.

items.label: CF Industries — Fertilizer Momentum, score 93
items.detail: CF Industries benefits from elevated commodity prices and food security concerns driven by Iran war disruption. Score 93/100. Entry $133, Stop $125, TP1 $150, TP2 $165, R:R 1:1.6. Top scanner pick.

items.label: SQQQ — Bear Market Hedge (tactical), score 86
items.detail: 3x inverse Nasdaq ETF. Nasdaq breaking 2026 lows. Tactical hedge for RISK-OFF environment. OpEx volatility may accelerate downside today. Entry $73.50, Stop $65, TP1 $85, TP2 $95. 1-2 week hold only (decay risk).

items.label: Russia — Benefiting from Oil Surge
items.detail: Russia emerging as early winner of Iran conflict. Elevated oil prices directly boost Kremlin revenues. Treasury Sec. Bessent issued 30-day waiver on Russian oil tariffs. Ukrainian drones struck Ilsky oil refinery. Ceasefire talks murky despite Zelensky statements.

items.label: Airlines Sector Collapse — Jet Fuel Shock
items.detail: Airline stocks down 8-9% on March 12 (DAL, UAL, LUV). European airlines (Ryanair -7.2%, Lufthansa -6.4%) also crushed. Jet fuel ~40% of airline costs. At $100 Brent, most airlines lose money on existing ticket prices. Watch for capacity cuts.

items.label: Bitcoin $66K — Extreme Fear
items.detail: Bitcoin at $66,587. Down 47% from October 2025 ATH of $126,073. Fear & Greed: 8/100 (Extreme Fear). BTC-Nasdaq correlation: 0.80. Critical support at $64K. Break → targets $58K. Oil de-escalation would trigger sharp relief rally.

items.label: China Relative Outperformer — Iranian Oil Discount
items.detail: CSI 300 +0.3% while global markets sell off. China receives sanctioned Iranian crude at steep discounts — benefiting from both cheaper energy AND a weakened competitor (US energy importers paying premium). Watch for further divergence if conflict extends.

items.label: Fed Chair Powell Term Ends — May 2026
items.detail: Jerome Powell's term expires May 15, 2026. Nomination battle will drive rate expectations. Hawkish replacement = bond selloff risk.

items.label: S&P 500 approaching 200DMA at 6,580
items.detail: S&P 500 at 6,672 approaching its 200-day moving average at ~6,580. A close below would be a major technical breakdown, historically triggering systematic selling from CTAs and risk parity funds. Watch level closely into OpEx.

items.label: US Debt Ceiling — Late Q2 2026
items.detail: Treasury extraordinary measures expected to run out by June-July 2026. Political brinkmanship risk with Congress focused on Iran war funding. Credit downgrade potential.

items.label: China-Taiwan Tensions — Ongoing
items.detail: Military exercises around Taiwan remain elevated. Any escalation would shock semis supply chain. Tail risk for tech sector amplified by current RISK-OFF environment.

items.label: US Midterm Elections — November 2026
items.detail: Congressional midterms in November 2026. Historical pattern: markets rally post-midterms. Pre-election volatility typically begins Q3.
